t.why: It sells a lot of gas to Europe. It cut ties with Morocco in 2021 over Western Sahara.
t.rel: Africa's largest country. It backs the Western Sahara independence movement and cut ties with Morocco in 2021, and it sells a lot of gas to Europe.
t.know: It won independence from France in 1962 after an eight-year war.
t.etext: Natural gas and oil make up most exports, and it pipes gas to Europe. The state holds a tight grip on the economy, so other industries have struggled to grow.
